description: Connects one subdomain, such as blog.example.com, to a blog or changelog hosted by Notra Sites. Only records on that subdomain are touched.
variableDescription: ownership is the per-hostname Cloudflare for SaaS verification value for _cf-custom-hostname. notraOwnership is Notra's public, site-and-hostname-bound ownership challenge for _notra; both TXT records are required.
